subject: math
description: Write and apply coordinate rules for translations, then graph preimages and images on the Cartesian plane.
learningObjectives: Describe a translation as a slide that preserves size, shape, and orientation
Write coordinate rules for horizontal, vertical, and combined translations
Apply rules of the form (x, y) -> (x + a, y + b)
Find image coordinates after a translation
Use preimage and image points to identify the translation rule
Graph a preimage and its translated image accurately
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
